name: Crawfish
siboNotes: Naturally FODMAP-free and well-tolerated. Watch for high-FODMAP seasonings like garlic and onion in Cajun preparations.
preparationTips: Season with FODMAP-friendly spices like paprika, cayenne, and herbs
Use garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic for flavor
Avoid pre-seasoned varieties that may contain onion or garlic powder
Boil with low-FODMAP vegetables like carrots and potatoes
